core: Oxidative phosphorylation via the mitochondrial respiratory chain
name: Oxidative phosphorylation gene program and respiratory electron transport chain
rationale: All members describe mitochondrial electron transport coupled to ATP synthesis; unlike the closest theme it also carries the broad oxidative-phosphorylation gene signature, and unlike others it lacks complex assembly or mitochondrial translation.

core: Mitochondrial electron transfer and chemiosmotic ATP formation
name: Ubiquinol-to-oxygen electron transfer and chemiosmotic ATP formation
rationale: Members are the respiratory chain, its ubiquinol-to-cytochrome c and cytochrome c-to-oxygen steps and chemiosmotic ATP synthesis, without the OXPHOS gene signature or the complex-assembly and mitochondrial translation content of confusables.

core: Mitochondrial transcription and translation
name: Mitochondrial transcription, translation and mitoribosome quality control
rationale: All members cover mitochondrial transcription initiation/termination, translation initiation/elongation/termination and mitochondrial ribosome-associated quality control, without the mtDNA repair, RNA processing or tRNA aminoacylation content of confusables.

core: Mitochondrial transcription and translation
name: Mitochondrial DNA maintenance, transcription and translation
rationale: Members span mitochondrial transcription and translation plus mtDNA repair, regulation of mtDNA metabolism and small subunit assembly, which distinguish it from the transcription/translation-only theme and from RNA-processing or replication confusables.

core: Neuroblast proliferation and regional neural differentiation
name: Neuroblast proliferation with forebrain patterning and retinal, pituitary differentiation
rationale: Members regulate neural progenitor proliferation and region-specific neural differentiation (midbrain dopaminergic, cerebellar), and uniquely add forebrain dorsoventral patterning/morphogenesis, photoreceptor differentiation and adenohypophysis development.

core: Neural progenitor division and neuronal differentiation
qualifier: asymmetric division, radial glia, neuron maturation
name: Neuroblast asymmetric division, radial glia differentiation and neuron maturation
rationale: Members cover neural progenitor proliferation and dopaminergic/neuronal differentiation, and are distinguished by asymmetric neuroblast division, forebrain radial and Bergmann glia differentiation, neuron maturation and retinal cell death.

core: Cortical neuron migration and lamination
name: Tangential interneuron migration and cortical regionalization and layering
rationale: Members are cortical tangential and GABAergic/olfactory interneuron precursor migration, cortex layering and regionalization, dentate gyrus development and radial glia-guided migration, without the tract morphogenesis or neuron-type commitment of supersets.

core: Forebrain neuron migration and specification
qualifier: commissural and corticospinal axon tract formation
name: Forebrain neuron migration, specification and commissural axon tract formation
rationale: Members span cortical neuron migration, lamination and neuron-type commitment, and uniquely add corpus callosum, anterior commissure and corticospinal tract morphogenesis plus radial glia differentiation.

core: Forebrain neuron migration
qualifier: migration control and pyramidal neuron-type commitment
name: Forebrain neuron migration control and pyramidal neuron-type commitment
rationale: Members cover cortical neuron migration and lamination plus positive/negative regulation of migration, forebrain neuron-type commitment, pyramidal neuron and thalamus development, without the axon tract morphogenesis of the larger theme.

core: Neutrophil respiratory burst and microbial killing
name: Neutrophil oxidative burst regulation and antibacterial, antifungal killing
rationale: All members concern neutrophil superoxide/respiratory burst regulation, degranulation and cytotoxic killing of bacteria and yeast, without the resident macrophage program, chemotaxis or TLR signaling of confusables.

core: Phagocyte respiratory burst and microbial killing
name: Phagocyte respiratory burst and killing, including resident macrophage program
rationale: Members cover neutrophil respiratory burst, degranulation and antimicrobial killing, and additionally include the tissue macrophage/microglial phagocyte program, restraint of neutrophil activation and mucus secretion.

core: NOD-like bacterial sensing with TAK1-JNK/p38 signaling
name: NOD-like bacterial sensing with positive and negative JNK/p38 regulation
rationale: Members are NOD1/2 and ALPK1 bacterial sensing with TAK1-mediated JNK/p38 activation and its negative regulation, without the TNF signaling of its superset or the TLR/NF-kB content of other confusables.

core: NOD1/2 bacterial sensing and stress-kinase signaling
name: NOD1/2 bacterial sensing with stress-kinase and TNF signaling regulation
rationale: Members combine NOD1/2 peptidoglycan sensing with TAK1-JNK/p38 activation and inhibition, and add positive regulation of TNF signaling and negative regulation of stress-activated kinase cascades.

core: NOD1/2 peptidoglycan sensing
name: NOD1/2 peptidoglycan sensing with K63 ubiquitination and inflammasome receptors
rationale: Members are NOD1/2 signaling and responses to peptidoglycan/muramyl dipeptide, distinguished by K63-linked ubiquitination and inflammasome receptor signaling, without the TAK1-MAPK/NF-kB content of confusables.

core: NOD1/NOD2 antibacterial signaling
name: Muramyl dipeptide-triggered NOD1/NOD2 antibacterial innate signaling
rationale: All six members are NOD1/NOD2 receptor signaling and cellular responses to peptidoglycan/muramyl dipeptide in antibacterial immunity, without inflammasome, ubiquitination or downstream kinase members.

core: NRF2 and HIF transcriptional programs
qualifier: NRF2 turnover and HIF oxygen sensing
name: NRF2 turnover and target genes with HIF oxygen sensing
rationale: Members are NFE2L2 regulation/degradation and its target gene sets plus HIF hydroxylation, signaling and hypoxia response, without the glycolysis, BACH1 or ferroptosis content of confusables.

core: NRF2 and HIF transcriptional programs
name: NRF2-BACH1 and HIF programs with glycolysis and pentose-phosphate shunt
rationale: Members are the NFE2L2 and HIF regulatory programs plus BACH1 activity, glycolysis and pentose-phosphate shunt regulation, which separate it from the plain NRF2/HIF theme.

core: Nuclear pore complex dynamics and inositol phosphate transport
name: Mitotic nuclear pore disassembly, reassembly and inositol phosphate shuttling
rationale: Members are NPC structure, mitotic disassembly and postmitotic reformation, NPC-mediated IP3-IP7 transport and Rev import, without the pore localization, gene tethering or RNA export of confusables.

core: Nuclear pore complex assembly and transport
qualifier: pore localization, gene tethering, HIV Rev
name: Nuclear pore assembly, localization, gene tethering and HIV Rev transport
rationale: Members cover NPC assembly/disassembly and inositol phosphate transport, and additionally nuclear pore localization, transcription-dependent gene tethering at the nuclear periphery and Rev-mediated HIV RNA export.

core: Osmotic stress response and renal ion transport
name: Cellular osmosensing and transepithelial sodium-chloride transport
rationale: The five members are hyper/hypotonic responses, osmosensory signaling, transepithelial chloride and renal sodium transport, without the aldosterone, salt-stress or potassium content of confusables.

core: Osmotic stress response and renal sodium transport
name: Osmotic and salt stress responses with aldosterone-regulated renal sodium handling
rationale: Members combine osmotic responses and transepithelial Na/Cl transport with salt stress, aldosterone response, sodium import regulation, water homeostasis and renin-angiotensin renal regulation.

core: Osteoclastogenesis and bone remodeling
name: Positive and negative control of osteoclastogenesis and bone remodeling
rationale: All members regulate osteoclast differentiation, proliferation, development and fusion and bone resorption/remodeling in both directions, without the DAP12, macrophage fusion or CSF1 content of confusables.

core: Osteoclastogenesis and bone resorption
name: Myeloid cell fusion and DAP12-linked osteoclastogenesis
rationale: Members cover osteoclast differentiation, fusion and bone resorption and are distinguished by macrophage fusion, syncytium/plasma membrane fusion and DAP12 signaling.

core: Peroxisomal fatty acid oxidation and lipid synthesis
name: Peroxisomal lipid metabolism with omega-oxidation, NAD(P) supply and fission
rationale: Members span peroxisomal alpha/beta-oxidation, VLCFA elongation and ether lipid synthesis, and additionally omega-oxidation, malonyl-/succinyl-CoA metabolism, NADP+ synthesis, NAD transport and peroxisome fission.

core: Peroxisomal fatty acid oxidation and lipid synthesis
name: Peroxisomal alpha/beta-oxidation with VLCFA, plasmalogen and wax synthesis
rationale: All members are peroxisomal alpha- and beta-oxidation, very long-chain and polyunsaturated fatty acid metabolism and plasmalogen/wax ether lipid synthesis, without the omega-oxidation, cofactor or fission content of its superset.
